hook: Swords lose their shape when they plunge deep into enemy flesh.

word.note: This word refers to the sharpened swords that lost their shape from plunging into the flesh of enemies.

excerpt: The swords, sharpened for battle, have lost their shape from plunging deep into the flesh of enemies while destroying their guarded fortresses. The spears, having breached the strongholds of rebel chiefs and ruined their lands rich in fragrant toddy, have shaken joints and bent shafts. The war elephants, battering doors secured with heavy wooden bolts...
